title: Air Cleaner Clogging
detail_of_failure: When the engine is running, the signal voltage of the air cleaner clogging switch is not 1 V or less. The machine monitor senses that the air cleaner is clogged (sensor contacts are opened).
controller_action: Shows the air cleaner clogging monitor in yellow on the machine monitor.
machine_effect: If machine is used as it is, the engine can be damaged.
related_information: Monitoring code The input (ON or OFF) from air cleaner clogging switch can be monitored. (Code: 04501)

steps.procedure: 1. Check the wiring harnesses and connectors. REMARK For details of checking method, see “RELATED INFORMATION TO TROUBLESHOOT”, “CHECKS BEFORE TROUBLESHOOTING”, “Electrical equipment”. 2. Are the wiring harnesses and connectors normal?

branches.YES: • The wiring harnesses and connectors are normal. • Go to the next inspection item.
branches.NO: • A wiring harness or connector is defective. • Repair or replace the defective wiring harness or connector. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.procedure: 1. Check the air cleaner for clogging. 2. Is the air cleaner normal?

branches.YES: • The air cleaner is normal. • Go to the next inspection item.
branches.NO: • The air cleaner is defective. • Clean or replace the air cleaner. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.
